description: FUNCTION LOCALE-COMPARE (ISO 15.51), LOCALE-DATE (15.52) and LOCALE-TIME (15.53) - the locale-based comparison returning '<' / '=' / '>' (15.51.4 r5/r6) over the named locale's (else the current LC_COLLATE's) cultural ordering, and the culturally formatted date and time per the locale's d_fmt / t_fmt (15.52.4 r2, 15.53.4 r2; DETERMINATION L10: the culture's short date / long time patterns). LIVE (kb/Work PB64 T4): CobolLocale.Compare / Date / Time over the ONE LocaleCollation carrier and LocaleFacts; the optional locale-name-1 is a SPECIAL-NAMES LOCALE clause's name (COBOL1664 otherwise). Below 2002 the D8 catalog window rejects by name+edition (COBOL1502) - the window is enforced now that the rows' Bind is Runtime (it was suppressed while they were Unsupported). The 2002 edge is the provisional window the catalog inherited (Annex E covers 2014-2023 only; kb/Work R28).
citation: ISO §2023:15.51 LOCALE-COMPARE; §2023:15.52 LOCALE-DATE; §2023:15.53 LOCALE-TIME; Annex A.4.9 items 2-4 (support IS now claimed); provisional 2002 edge
vcr: 2002 introduction (the locale facility's functions; the edge is the provisional catalog window — the 2023 text proves only presence in 2014, Annex E lists no locale delta)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. PB64T4F.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
SPECIAL-NAMES.
    LOCALE FR IS "fr-FR".
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 R PIC X.
01 S PIC X(20).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    MOVE FUNCTION LOCALE-COMPARE("a" "b" FR) TO R.
    MOVE FUNCTION LOCALE-DATE("20260819") TO S.
    MOVE FUNCTION LOCALE-TIME("130509" FR) TO S.
    STOP RUN.
